prompt: Which set director born in 1936 won the Academy Award for Best Production Design during the 71st Academy Awards?
answer: Jill Quertier won the Academy Award for Best Production Design (then called Best Art Direction–Set Decoration) at the 71st Academy Awards for *Shakespeare in Love*.
